defining_action_en: move, orient, align or scan an in-vivo sensor to change the next observation
defining_action_cn: 移动、定向、对准或扫描在体传感器，从而改变下一次观察
terminal_diagnostic_evidence_en: in-vivo image, sound or physiological signal
terminal_diagnostic_evidence_cn: 在体影像、声音或生理信号
include_if_en: the physical action changes acquisition geometry, coverage or contact and the diagnostic endpoint remains an in-vivo observation
include_if_cn: 物理动作改变采集几何、覆盖范围或接触状态，且诊断终点仍为在体观察
exclude_or_reassign_if_en: material is removed for ex-vivo testing (1.3), or a controlled perturbation is interpreted through its elicited response (1.2)
exclude_or_reassign_if_cn: 若取出材料进行离体检测则归 1.3；若通过受控扰动及其诱发响应形成证据则归 1.2
carrier_scope_en: robot arm, motorized probe, steerable endoscope, active or magnetic capsule, or another controllable physical carrier
carrier_scope_cn: 机械臂、电动探头、可控内镜、主动或磁控胶囊，以及其他可控物理载体

defining_action_en: apply a controlled mechanical, acoustic, electrical or neurophysiological perturbation
defining_action_cn: 施加受控的机械、声学、电或神经生理扰动
terminal_diagnostic_evidence_en: elicited deformation, force, physiological or functional response
terminal_diagnostic_evidence_cn: 诱发的形变、力、生理或功能响应
include_if_en: stimulus parameters or contact are purposeful diagnostic actions and the response is measured to infer state
include_if_cn: 刺激参数或接触是有目的的诊断动作，并通过测量响应推断状态
exclude_or_reassign_if_en: force is used only for safe positioning (1.1), or the terminal evidence is an ex-vivo sample result (1.3)
exclude_or_reassign_if_cn: 若力仅用于安全定位则归 1.1；若终点证据来自离体样本结果则归 1.3
carrier_scope_en: robotic or mechatronic actuator, controlled stimulator or instrumented contact device
carrier_scope_cn: 机器人或机电执行器、可控刺激器、带传感器的接触装置

defining_action_en: puncture, aspirate, cut, swab or collect material from the patient
defining_action_cn: 从患者获取穿刺、抽吸、切取、拭子或其他材料
terminal_diagnostic_evidence_en: ex-vivo pathological, cytological, biochemical, microbiological or molecular result, including sample adequacy
terminal_diagnostic_evidence_cn: 离体病理、细胞学、生化、微生物或分子结果，包括样本充分性
include_if_en: the action obtains diagnostic material and sampling or adequacy is part of the sensing-decision-action-feedback pathway
include_if_cn: 动作获得诊断材料，且取样或充分性判断进入感知—决策—行动—反馈链
exclude_or_reassign_if_en: needle or endoscope motion is purely therapeutic, or imaging alone is the diagnostic endpoint (1.1)
exclude_or_reassign_if_cn: 若针具或内镜动作仅用于治疗则排除；若影像本身是诊断终点则归 1.1
carrier_scope_en: robot arm, needle or biopsy device, endoscope, capsule, venipuncture system or specimen-collection platform
carrier_scope_cn: 机械臂、穿刺或活检装置、内镜、胶囊、静脉穿刺系统或标本采集平台
